notes.scope: The eight tiered passive blessings offered by Ram, Owl, Deer, and Bat statues in the cave system.
notes.valuePolicy: Effects are qualitative because the checked sources do not publish stable percentages. Tier II is recorded only as stronger than tier I.
notes.imagePolicy: Text-first collection. Available screenshots show cave or statue environments rather than distinct row-level blessing icons.

item.name: Blessing of the Ram I
item.bestFor: Runs where lightning is causing dangerous weather interruptions.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The first Ram tier reduces lightning pressure during stormy runs.

item.name: Blessing of the Ram II
item.effect: Reduces lightning occurrence further than Ram I.
item.bestFor: Runs that need the strongest available reduction in lightning interruptions.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The stronger Ram tier pushes lightning frequency lower than the first tier.

item.name: Blessing of the Owl I
item.bestFor: Runs where rain and wet weather are making travel or fights harder.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The first Owl tier makes rainy weather less likely during the run.

item.name: Blessing of the Owl II
item.effect: Reduces rain frequency further than Owl I.
item.bestFor: Runs that need the strongest available reduction in rainy weather.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The stronger Owl tier lowers rain frequency beyond the first tier.

item.name: Blessing of the Deer I
item.bestFor: Runs that need more daylight for gathering, travel, and objectives.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The first Deer tier trades some night length for a longer daylight window.

item.name: Blessing of the Deer II
item.effect: Extends daytime and shortens nighttime further than Deer I.
item.bestFor: Runs that need the strongest available daylight extension.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The stronger Deer tier gives a larger shift toward daylight than the first tier.

item.name: Blessing of the Bat I
item.effect: Slows the rate at which hunger drains.
item.bestFor: Runs where food use and hunger pressure are the main resource problem.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The first Bat tier slows hunger drain and reduces pressure on the food supply.

item.name: Blessing of the Bat II
item.effect: Slows hunger drain further than Bat I.
item.bestFor: Runs that need the strongest available reduction in food pressure.
item.accessNotes: Clear a cave and reach a statue room to choose from the offered statues.
item.choiceRule: Choosing the statue locks this blessing into one of your blessing slots for the run.
item.cardSummary: The stronger Bat tier stretches food supplies further than the first tier.
